# Flawless Bio Clean LLC

> Flawless Bio Clean LLC is an Arizona maid service and home-cleaning company serving all of Arizona. Its core work is recurring maid service, deep cleaning, move-out cleaning and Airbnb turnover cleaning for homes, plus commercial cleaning. The company also provides certified specialty cleaning — crime scene, biohazard, cleanroom and data center cleaning — through its owner, Yvette Valenti. Tagline: "Clean. Safe. Flawless. Down to a science."

## Contact

- Phone: (480) 589-6200
- Email: info@flawlessbclean.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 8 AM–5 PM
- Service area: All of Arizona (statewide)
- Website: https://flawlessbclean.com

## Founder

- Yvette Valenti — Owner & Founder. Family business.
- Seven years of professional cleaning experience. She built the business cleaning homes and Airbnbs, then expanded into commercial and certified specialty cleaning.

## Certifications (held by the owner)

- Crime Scene Cleaning
- Biohazard Cleaning
- Cleanroom Cleaning
- Data Center Cleaning

## Services

- [Residential & Maid Service](https://flawlessbclean.com/services/residential.html): Recurring maid service, deep cleaning, move-out cleaning and Airbnb turnover cleaning for homes across Arizona.
- [Commercial Cleaning](https://flawlessbclean.com/services/commercial.html): Scheduled cleaning for offices, workplaces, schools and specialty facilities.
- [Cleanroom & Lab Cleaning](https://flawlessbclean.com/services/cleanroom.html): Cleaning for cleanrooms and laboratories, working to facility-supplied protocols.
- [Medical Office Cleaning](https://flawlessbclean.com/services/medical.html): Cleaning and sanitation programs for medical and dental offices.
- [Data Center Cleaning](https://flawlessbclean.com/services/datacenter.html): Careful cleaning for data centers and server rooms.
- [Biohazard & Crime Scene Cleaning](https://flawlessbclean.com/services/biohazard.html): Certified biohazard and crime scene cleaning, including hoarding cleanups and disinfection.
- [Semiconductor Facility Cleaning](https://flawlessbclean.com/services/semiconductor.html): Cleaning support for semiconductor and microelectronics environments.
- [Post-Construction Cleaning](https://flawlessbclean.com/services/construction.html): Final cleaning after construction, fit-outs and renovations.

## Key facts

- Family-owned and operated; work is performed by in-house technicians, never subcontracted crews.
- Homes and Airbnbs are the core of the business; the certified specialties are additional services the company also provides.
- Statewide Arizona coverage from one company and one standard of care.
- Consultations start with a conversation — call (480) 589-6200 or email info@flawlessbclean.com. No instant online price quote is offered.
